name: GitHub Autopush
summary: Keeps local repos moving to GitHub with readable commits and a background LaunchAgent.
story: Ship While You Sleep, but for the pile of local experiments. I make a lot of small things; this keeps the good ones from living only on one laptop.

launcher.long: Installs a background LaunchAgent that automatically commits and pushes your git repos to GitHub on a schedule. Set it up once and your projects stay synced without you remembering to push.
